size_basis: reactor-class study minimum; DN150 at 1 d hold-up of the naphtha feed at 750 kg/m3 melt density; wall by ASME VIII-1 UG-27 at 5 MPa (node envelope basis)
solids_note: the skid chain (plinth, stand, vessel, drain and vent) fuses to one solid; the face-stub connections stay separate until the connecting lines make their joints

vessel.wall_basis: node design wall_mm (UG-27 at the 5 MPa design, AQS-SIZE-OIL-POLY op window 150-250 C at 1-5 MPa)

internals.source: none: the node internals row is none and the node names no agitator and no jacket

a_ves.basis: the node envelope basis books the 1 d hold-up of the 0.2941 kg/d naphtha feed at 750 kg/m3 (an existing basis); the gross shell volume is reported from the model and no residence time beyond the node basis is derived (A-VES)

material.basis: duty section 3 (the node design row matches): SA-240 316L, welded (ASME IX); CA 0 mm (AQS-STD-001 rule)

N1.note: schedule datum drawn as issued; DN15 open-bore tube flush at the envelope face (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the connecting line makes the joint at the face)

N2.note: schedule datum drawn as issued; DN15 open-bore tube flush at the envelope face (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the connecting line makes the joint at the face)

N3.note: schedule datum drawn as issued; non-piped solids transfer (line-list classification): drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4) flush at the envelope face (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the connecting line makes the joint at the face)

N4.note: schedule datum drawn as issued; DN15 open-bore tube flush at the envelope face (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the connecting line makes the joint at the face)

N5.note: drain boss under the base head, flush at the envelope bottom (schedule datum 50)

N6.note: vent riser on the top head, flush at the envelope top; the schedule datum 800 is the placeholder (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric open-bore tube connections flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; the W4 110 percent rule draws no flange where no process pressure is stated); the schedule rating column (Class 150) is carried verbatim as text; datums draw as issued; the N3 solids row drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4)
